nodes.name: Hydrothermal NiS2 synthesis
nodes.procedure: The precursors were dissolved in water and stirred with ethylene glycol and oxalic acid for 20 min before being transferred into a Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave, then heated at 180 °C for 12 h in an electric oven and cooled to room temperature naturally. Finally, the product was washed with deionized water and ethanol and dried overnight in a vacuum oven at 60 °C.

nodes.source_text: Luo et al. fabricated NiS2 hollow microspheres using a hydrothermal approach with Ni(NO3)2 and Na2S2O3 solutions as the Ni and S sources, respectively.67

nodes.name: Annealing transformation
nodes.procedure: The obtained NiS2 hollow microspheres were annealed under a mixed atmosphere to transform into NiS porous hollow microspheres.
nodes.source_text: when annealed under a mixed atmosphere, the obtained NiS2 hollow microspheres could further be transformed into NiS porous hollow microspheres

nodes.name: Hydrothermal CoS hierarchical synthesis
nodes.procedure: Hierarchical CoS with flower-like, ball-like, cube-like, and hollowed-out nanostructures via the one-pot hydrothermal reaction of Co(NO3)2·6H2O and thiourea. Thiourea played an important role in the reaction, as it decomposed to produce S2- for the formation of CoS and served as a structure-directing agent to control the growth of CoS crystals.
nodes.source_text: Dong et al. synthesized hierarchical CoS with flower-like... via the one-pot hydrothermal reaction of Co(NO3)2·6H2O and thiourea.68

nodes.name: Hydrothermal Co-doped MoS2
nodes.procedure: (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O, thiourea, and Co(NO3)2·6H2O were applied as the precursors for the hydrothermal preparation of MoS2 nanosheets covalently doped with Co.
nodes.source_text: Xiong et al. prepared Co-doped MoS2 nanosheets... via a facile one-step hydrothermal approach.

nodes.name: Solvothermal MoS2/RGO
nodes.procedure: MoS2 nanoparticles on reduced graphene oxide (RGO) sheets via the one-step selective solvothermal reaction of (NH4)2MoS4 and hydrazine in an N,N-dimethylformamide (DMF) solution of graphene oxide (GO) sheets at 200 °C.
nodes.source_text: Li et al. prepared MoS2 nanoparticles on reduced graphene oxide (RGO) sheets via the one-step selective solvothermal reaction...

nodes.name: Chemical intercalation exfoliation
nodes.procedure: Chemical intercalation method via the incorporation of sub-stoichiometric amounts of n-butyllithium (BuLi) to controllably exfoliate MoS2 crystals into trilayer nanosheets. The intercalated lithium at the edges of the MoS2 crystals could serve as a wedge to promote the exfoliation of MoS2 via solvent molecules with a yield of 11–15 wt% exfoliated nanosheets in ethanol/water mixtures.
nodes.source_text: Fan et al. developed a chemical intercalation method via the incorporation of sub-stoichiometric amounts of n-butyllithium (BuLi) to controllably exfoliate MoS2 crystals into trilayer nanosheets

nodes.name: Liquid phase exfoliation WS2
nodes.procedure: WS2 nanodots prepared via liquid-phase exfoliation from bulk crystals with the aid of ultrasonication in surfactant aqueous solution.
nodes.source_text: Zhao et al. prepared WS2 nanodots... via liquid-phase exfoliation from bulk crystals with the aid of ultrasonication in surfactant aqueous solution.
